description: OpenDrift models transport and fate of drifting objects and substances in the ocean and atmosphere. Its Python framework supports application-specific processes for oil, search and rescue and other particle types, driven by currents, wind and waves. The resource is documented by OpenDrift developers. Transport occurs within the spatial and temporal coverage of the supplied current, wind and wave forcing; output uses CF-compliant netCDF. The documentation is publicly accessible. Licence: GPL-2.0. Access is described as free. Dataset contents, software execution and reported outcomes were not independently tested. The resource can support infrastructure modelling; suitability for a specific simulation requires checking its inputs and assumptions.
